title: Design: Page menu shows Audit Log
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-13-page-menu-audit-log.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" button beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A small menu opens under the button with one item, "Audit Log", with no icon, as wide as the item (as in ct-p1-13-page-menu-audit-log.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R1: “The Credit Terms page header has a "⋯" page menu top right, beside "New Credit Term", with one item: "Audit Log".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Page "⋯" menu item | "Audit Log" | Menu item, opens the "Credit Terms Log" window”
